name: Codex session
description: Installs the Codex CLI and a 'codex-session' bin that keeps one logged-in Codex session rolling forward through restic: restore it, run a review with it, back it up again.

version.description: Version of the @openai/codex npm package to install.

model.description: Model Codex uses (written to config.toml). Empty keeps Codex's own default.

tag.description: restic snapshot tag the session is restored from and backed up to.
